\par\smallskip\raggedright\footnotesize\textit{Source: Authors' own work.} EARS, mean $\pm$ SD over 10 seeds, 30 explained instances per seed (same instances for every configuration within a seed). Removal curves are computed on the model being explained: features are replaced in SHAP order, at random (20 orders) or in reverse order; effect $e(k)=|f(x)-\mathbb{E}f(x_{\setminus k})|$ divided by the SD of $f$ over 200 training rows; AUC = mean of $e(k)$ over $k=0..43$. Conditional replacement copies the removed features jointly from one of the 10 nearest training rows on the retained features; marginal replacement draws each feature independently. Gap = SHAP AUC $-$ random AUC (positive: SHAP ranks features the model actually relies on). Agreement: Spearman correlation with the centralised model's (E0) SHAP vector on the same instance, a divergence measure, not fidelity. Stability: Spearman between repeated SHAP runs.
